scientific_integrity: Exact projector calculation and perturbative proof with reproducible symbolic and numerical checks. The stationary channel and spectral formula are explicitly credited to the originating source. Publication priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Local asymptotic in a fixed two-qubit entangling generator, global Bernoulli resetting, and angles near pi/4 or 3pi/4; no general gate, non-Markov resetting, noisy-channel, or full concurrence phase-diagram theorem.
title: Quadratic weak-reset entanglement tongues at two resonant two-qubit gates
